data.title: Swell Surge Watch: Udupi
data.description: Swell Surge Watch for the coast of UDUPI,KARNATAKA from Baindur To Kapu. Swell waves in the range of 15.0 - 17.0 sec period with 0.5 - 0.7 m height are forecasted during  17:30 hours on 14-11-2026 to 23:30 hours on 16-11-2026. It advised that no immediate action is required. Check for updates.
